@aio:claude-modules: `multipart/form-data` bodies go through `safeUpload` (multer, any parse failure becomes a
400 `INVALID_BODY` instead of an unhandled 500) followed by `validateFormData(schema, opts)`,
which reads a JSON payload from the `data` field plus files from `opts.fileFields`, merges
them, and validates the result into `res.locals.input` — same contract as `validateBody`.
Uploaded files are served back from `GET /media/:filename` (public by default; move it
behind auth in `routes/index.routes.ts` if needed). See `src/middlewares/upload.ts`.
